extracted.name: Strip and Go Naked
extracted.description: This party-sized version of the classic vodka, beer and lemonade cocktail is recommended to consume before a Nebraska football game.
ingredient_lines: 30 (12 fluid ounce) cans or bottles Keystone Light beer
2 (12 ounce) cans frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
instruction_lines: In a 4 to 5 gallon sports drink dispenser, combine the light beer, vodka and lemonade concentrate. Stir gently to disperse the lemonade. Put the lid on and serve.
